papers.paper_title: EXAMINATION PAPER 1: II SEMESTER MGU UGP25 - MARCH - 2025

questions.question: Identify the year in which the ICESCR officially come into force a). 1948 b). 1960 c). 1972 d). 1976
questions.solution_html: Correct Answer: (d) 1976.

questions.question: Which of the following is a Sustainable Development Goal ( SDG) related to economic disparity and human security a). Climate action b). Zero hunger c). Industry, Innovation and infrastructure d). Reduced Inequalities
questions.solution_html: Correct Answer: (d) Reduced Inequalities.

questions.question: Which of the following international agreements was adopted under the UNFCCC framework? a). Vienna Convention b). Kyoto Protocol c). Montreal Protocol d). Basel Convention
questions.solution_html: Correct Answer: (b) Kyoto Protocol.

questions.question: Which UN body is responsible for promoting and protecting human rights globally? a). UNDP b). UNESCO c). UNHRC d). WHO
questions.solution_html: Correct Answer: (c) UNHRC.

questions.question: The main goal of the Paris Agreement is to limit global temperature rise to: a). 1°C above pre-industrial levels b). Below 2°C, preferably 1.5°C above pre-industrial levels c). 3°C above pre-industrial levels d). 4°C above pre-industrial levels
questions.solution_html: Correct Answer: (b) Below 2°C, preferably 1.5°C above pre-industrial levels.
questions.final_answer: Option (b) Below 2°C, preferably 1.5°C above pre-industrial levels.

questions.question: Human security places emphasis on a). The power of the state b). Military alliances c). The individual as the referent object of security d). Exansion of national borders
questions.solution_html: Correct Answer: (c) The individual as the referent object of security.
questions.final_answer: Option (c) The individual as the referent object of security.

questions.question: Which government body replaced the Planning Commission and now looks at poverty estimation? a). NITI Aayog b). Ministry of Finance c). Supreme Court of India d). Election Commission of India
questions.solution_html: Correct Answer: (a) NITI Aayog.

questions.question: Which gas contributes the most to the greenhouse effect? / a). Oxygen b). Carbon dioxide c). Nitrogen d). Hydrogen
questions.solution_html: Correct Answer: (b) Carbon dioxide effect.

questions.question: The second generation of human rights focuses on: / a). Individual freedoms and political rights b). Social, economic, and cultural rights c). Group and collective rights d). Religious rights
questions.solution_html: Correct Answer: (b) Social, economic, and cultural rights.
questions.final_answer: Option (b) Social, economic, and cultural rights.

questions.question: Which section of society is the primary target of the AAY scheme? / a). Middle-class families b). Farmers with large land holdings c). Poorest of the poor households d). Government employees
questions.solution_html: Correct Answer: (c) Poorest of the poor households.
questions.final_answer: Option (c) Poorest of the poor households.

questions.question: Define the Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR) and identify its contribution to human security.
questions.solution_html:
• The Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR) is a foundational document adopted
  • by the UN in 1948, establishing universal human rights standards, thus promoting global
  • human security and dignity.

questions.question: Explain how international trade policies affect human security in developing nations.
questions.solution_html:
• International trade policies can either promote economic stability or exacerbate inequalities
  • affecting job security, access to essential goods, and overall economic resilience in developing
  • nations.

questions.question: Discuss the role of political participation in promoting human security.
questions.solution_html:
• Political participation empowers citizens, promotes accountability, and ensures inclusive
  • governance, reducing the risk of conflict and enhancing community security and social
  • cohesion.

questions.question: Develop an ethical framework for decision-making in humanitarian interventions.
questions.solution_html:
• An ethical framework for humanitarian interventions prioritizes impartiality, non
  • discrimination, and the protection of vulnerable populations while respecting sovereignty and
  • minimizing unintended harm.

questions.question: Discuss how lack of access to nutritious food affects human health and well-being
questions.solution_html:
• Inadequate access to nutritious food impairs physical and cognitive development, increases
  • susceptibility to diseases, and perpetuates poverty, undermining overall health and societal
  • well-being.

questions.question: Examine how deforestation contributes to climate change.
questions.solution_html:
• Deforestation accelerates climate change by releasing stored carbon, disrupting ecosystems
  • and reducing natural carbon sinks, thereby increasing environmental and human vulnerability.
questions.final_answer: Deforestation accelerates climate change by releasing stored carbon, disrupting ecosystems

questions.question: State how political stability or instability affects human security.
questions.solution_html:
• Political stability fosters economic development, social cohesion, and law enforcement
  • while instability breeds conflict, displacement, and insecurity, undermining human rights and
  • basic needs.

questions.question: Illustrate the role of political decisions in shaping outcomes of human security during natural disasters.
questions.solution_html:
• Political decisions during natural disasters determine resource allocation, emergency
  • response, and recovery efforts-effective governance can mitigate damage and protect
  • vulnerable populations, while poor planning exacerbates human insecurity through inadequate
  • infrastructure, delayed relief, and unequal access to essential services.
questions.final_answer: infrastructure, delayed relief, and unequal access to essential services

questions.question: Explain the role of WHO in addressing pandemics.
questions.solution_html:
• World Health Organization (WHO) coordinates global pandemic responses by monitoring
  • disease outbreaks, providing guidelines, supporting national health systems, and facilitating
  • vaccine distribution, thereby reducing health disparities and promoting public health security
  • on a global scale.

questions.question: Examine the role of the Human Rights Commission in promoting Human Security in India.
questions.solution_html:
• India’s Human Rights Commission addresses violations, promotes awareness, and
  • recommends policies to protect marginalized communities, ensuring that human rights
  • principles are integrated into national security frameworks and reducing risks of discrimination
  • and abuse.

questions.question: Discuss the influence of politics on the human security policies in the modern cotext.
questions.solution_html:
• Politics shapes human security policies by influencing budget allocations, enforcement of
  • human rights, and prioritization of security threats-power dynamics, political agendas, and
  • international relations impact the implementation and effectiveness of security measures
  • affecting vulnerable populations.
